verdict.rationale: The pack holds verbatim text pulled from many public GOV.UK guidance pages, including the Skilled Worker, Innovator Founder, Global Talent and visa processing times pages. That implies the public reading surface returned real content rather than a bot wall or empty JS shell. But no item states access conditions for automated agents, so reachability is inferred from captured content, not documented. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of keyless fetches with an identified user agent, confirmation of no CAPTCHA or bot challenge, confirmation that content is server-rendered rather than JS-dependent, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the service's published guidance pages are reachable by a keyless agent with a standard identified user agent — no bot wall, JS-only shell, or CAPTCHA in front of the public reading surface
